check_or_declaration: rank_weight INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rank_weight>=0)
singleton INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1)

description: 发布清单中的资源版本
check_or_declaration: resource_version TEXT NOT NULL
manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(instr(manifest_sha256,char(0))=0 AND (length(manifest_sha256)=64 AND manifest_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'))
index_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(index_schema_version>0)

description: 词形/读音键规范化规则版本
check_or_declaration: normalization_version TEXT NOT NULL
built_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(built_at_ms>=0)
entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dictionary_entries(entry_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
sense_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sense_index>=0)
gloss_language TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(gloss_language IN ('zh','en'))
gloss_text TEXT NOT NULL
usage_notes TEXT

description: 来源页/条目定位，遵循原数据许可
check_or_declaration: source_locator TEXT NOT NULL
source_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
display_name TEXT NOT NULL
snapshot_version TEXT NOT NULL
source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(instr(source_sha256,char(0))=0 AND (length(source_sha256)=64 AND source_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'))

description: 原来源定位，不在运行时自动联网
check_or_declaration: source_url TEXT NOT NULL
license_ref TEXT NOT NULL
attribution_text TEXT NOT NULL
